Abebook.author: Duckworth, George E.
Abebook.title: The Nature of Roman Comedy: A Study in Popular Entertainment
Abebook.subject: Roman comedy; Latin drama; Plautus; Terence; classics; classical studies; ancient theater; Latin literature; Richard Hunter; University of Oklahoma Press
Abebook.description: Second edition of Duckworth's standard study of Plautus and Terence, first published by Princeton in 1952, reissued by the University of Oklahoma Press in 1994 with a foreword and bibliographical appendix by Richard Hunter. Trade paperback in glossy black wrappers; no dust jacket, as issued. A very good copy: the glossy front wrapper carries light surface scratches and scuffing, there is a small crease at the head of the spine, and the cover edges and corners show light rubbing with a few faint marks to the rear wrapper. The spine is uncreased and the binding tight; the text is clean and unmarked throughout. Includes eight plates of scenes and characters from the comedies.
